comments.comment: RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: interactive code 27 collects unreserved actors and friendly unit targets; a normal-status target at morale 100 is rejected, while execution-mode validation separately rejects status 8.

RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: interactive code 28 requires at least 3000 troops at the source object, unreserved actors and friendly unit targets; execution-mode validation additionally requires target troops below capacity.

RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: automatic inspire uses the shared action gate, targets status-not-8 units with morale at most 80, filters actors by current effective intelligence 45..115, and converges on the interactive command.

RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: automatic reinforce uses the shared action gate, target/origin/actor lists and source-retention thresholds; actors are filtered by current effective leadership 45..115 and converge on the interactive command.

RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: automatic reinforce target requires at least 3000 free troop capacity, morale at least 25, excludes event type 51, and gates types 39, 40..50 and 52 through the target virtual predicate.
RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: inspire submission reserves participants and stores a stable rnd(100) roll in a type-27 event; it deducts neither troops nor funds/food.

RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: reinforce submission reserves participants, immediately deducts 3000 troops from the source object, records source morale, and stores a stable rnd(100) roll in a type-28 event.

RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: inspire success is stored_roll < live formula-5 threshold; it applies status 8 for 3+trunc0(target leader current leadership/10), adds 20 morale, clears member tactic intervals and attempts intelligence growth. Failure loses 1..5 morale.

RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: reinforce success is stored_roll < live formula-10 threshold; success adds up to 3000 troops, blends target/source morale, clears statuses other than 1 or 8, and attempts leadership growth. Failure still adds up to 15*executed leadership troops and blends morale; neither branch writes wounded troops.
RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: adds min(target capacity-current troops, requested amount) to target troop count with cap 60000; it does not read or write wounded troops.

RE-SAN9PK-0114 [confirmed]: wraps one target object in a temporary list and sends it to the main-map effect path; reinforce success calls it with effect code 13. It is presentation, not a wounded-troop mutation.
